## Behind the Site

- This website is inspired by the clean aesthetics of [Andrew Heiss's website](https://www.andrewheiss.com/).
- This website is build with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and hosted by [GitHub Pages](https://pages.github.com/).
- I use [Google Analytics](https://analytics.google.com/) to keep an eye on how visitors interact with the site and to improve the experience over time.
- The live weather widget in the footer is designed with the workflow:
    - Get the user's approximate location of the IP address geo-location by this [API](https://ip-check-perf.radar.cloudflare.com/api/info), the location may be inaccurate while it doesn't need to request the user for permission to access the precise location.
    - Get the current weather information for the location by [Open-Meteo API](https://open-meteo.com/).
    - Display the weather information, the pretty, animated weather icons are from [Meteocons](https://meteocons.com/) licensed under [MIT](https://opensource.org/license/mit).



## Typography

- The fonts below used in this website are open source fonts from [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/):
    - Heading & footer: `Ubuntu`
    - Navbar: `Raleway`
    - Body: `Open Sans`
    - Code: `Google Sans Code` (the same one I use in my code editor)
    - Grandtour card title: `Style Script`
- Poem, my name and favicon: `一点颜体` licensed under [GPL-2.0](https://opensource.org/license/gpl-2.0) from [Yanti](https://github.com/wordshub/free-font#%E4%B8%80%E7%82%B9%E9%A2%9C%E4%BD%93).


## Beyond the Screen

### The Name

My first name is `Wenyu`(<img class="inline-svg filter-color-to-body" src="./files/wenyu.svg" alt="wenyu Logo"/>, 文宇), and my family name is `Liu`(<img class="inline-svg filter-color-to-body" src="./files/liu.svg" alt="liu Logo"/>, 刘).

### Passions & Curiosities

- I appreciate and believe in the power of clear and beautiful visual expressions.
- I like to explore new and interesting ideas.
- I have a deep appreciation for classical music. While [Johann Sebastian Bach](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Johann_Sebastian_Bach) remains my "all-time" favorite, [Gustav Mahler](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gustav_Mahler) has profoundly influenced my perspective in recent years.
- I am a dedicated fan of football. I support Shaanxi Union FC <img class="inline-svg filter-color-to-body" src="./files/sufc-opt.svg" alt="sufc OPT Logo"/><img class="inline-svg filter-color-to-body" src="./files/sufc-wolf.svg" alt="sufc Logo"/> and China national team <img class="inline-svg filter-color-to-body" src="./files/cfa-no-margin.svg" alt="CFA Logo"/>.
- Sometimes I’ve turned "sleeping too much" into an art form.
- I really like coriander.

<div id="poem">
天雖長 地雖久
金玉滿堂應不守
富貴百年能幾何
死生一度人皆有
孤猿坐啼墳上月
且須一盡杯中酒
